entries.title: Atomic Society

emulation.notes: Use a native owned/preserved PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Atomic Society is a Windows post-apocalyptic town-building strategy game from Far Road Games. Steam still exposes the page and system requirements, but also marks the game as no longer available on the Steam store. No sourced console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass, so the archive route is a preserved owned Windows PC copy rather than a currently purchasable storefront route.
primary.how_to_play: Use an already-owned Steam copy or other legally preserved Windows PC build. Recheck availability before planning a new purchase, because Steam currently marks it as no longer available.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC build, but currently delisted from the Steam storefront.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release platform; archive access depends on ownership/preservation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform split was found; the main caveat is current storefront delisting.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found. Storefront delisting should be documented before any archive run.
